findings.claim: The body says the coverage is 'Per its chapters, description and captions' while the cautions (line 53) say 'the video has no chapters'. The stated provenance contradicts itself.
findings.recommendation: Change line 40 to 'Per its caption track' (or name the actual source of the time ranges) so the body and the cautions agree.

findings.claim: The o1 gap says mobile-first base styles with min-width queries are not taught, but does not say what kind of media query the video's demo uses. If the demonstration page relies on max-width (desktop-first) queries, a beginner sees the opposite pattern to the page's o1 method with no warning. This critic could not confirm the query direction because the caption endpoint was rate-limited (HTTP 429).
findings.recommendation: Check the captions or demo and, if the example uses max-width queries, add a caution: 'The demo's media query is written desktop-first (max-width); this topic writes mobile-first min-width queries. The viewport meta element works the same either way.'

findings.claim: The video description opens with a link to the creator's paid course 'Conquering Responsive Layouts' and later course and Patreon links. The box-model companion cautions about this kind of promotion; this one does not.
findings.recommendation: Add 'the description links to the creator's paid course; none is needed for this topic' to the cautions.
